title: On NFP, price spikes both ways — before 9:30

hero.caption: of NFP days **take out both the high and the low** of the little range built just before the 8:30 print. And it's usually done before the 9:30 cash open.

chart.label: How NFP takes out the pre-release range
chart.sub: Reference range = the 08:15–08:30 ET consolidation right before the print
chart.note: The whipsaw is a premarket event — by the New York open both the high and the low are usually already gone.

useIt: NFP fakes both directions — it takes out the high and the low of the pre-release range — and the round-trip is usually finished before New York opens. Don't trust the first 8:30 spike as direction; the other side gets taken too.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested on 10y NQ · check it yourself
